title: Maryam and the palm tree
hook: Alone, in pain, under a palm tree

phrases.text: Alone, in pain, she held on to the trunk of a palm tree.
Maryam, the mother of Prophet Isa, was a devout woman chosen by Allah.
An angel brought her news of a son, though no man had ever touched her.
When the pains of childbirth came, she went to a remote place, to the trunk of a palm tree.
She said: I wish I had died before this, and was completely forgotten.
Then a voice called to her: do not grieve. Your Lord has placed a stream beneath you.
And it told her what to do.
Even at her weakest, she was asked to take one small step… and Allah provided the rest.
Share this with a mother you love.
